How male gametes reach the ovary
Key Concept: Pollen transfers from the
anther to sticky stigma, growing a tube to ovary.
WORD BANK (Drag Labels to Target Slots)
Composed of Stigma (sticky top), Style (tube), and Ovary (swollen base with ovules).
Composed of Anther (pollen sacs) supported by a slender Filament.
Petals attract pollinators; Sepals protect the bud; Receptacle supports the flower base.
